extracted.name: Mincemeat Cookies
extracted.description: If you've never heard of mincemeat, know this, there is no meat in it. Mincemeat is a spiced blend of diced apples and raisins and is absolutely AMAZING as a cookie. I hope you enjoy this version of the delightful cookies!
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. In a medium bowl whisk together flour, salt, baking soda, and cinnamon. Set aside.
In the bowl of a stand mixer add butter, white sugar, and brown sugar. Beat on low to cream together.
Add all 3 eggs and vanilla. Continue to beat on medium speed for 2 minutes until well combined. Scrape down sides of bowl. Add mincemeat. Stir by hand to incorporate.
Add 1/2 of flour mixture. Beat on low until just incorporated. Scrape down sides of bowl. Add remainder of flour mixture. Beat on low again until just incorporated.
Drop 2 tbs of batter for each cookie onto baking sheet, spaced 2-3 inches apart. Bake in oven for 10 minutes.
Let cool on baking sheet for 10 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. Repeat baking process until all batter is used up. Enjoy!
